title: No Effect needed for derived data

slides.text: An Effect just to copy data? 🙅
slides.say: A very common unnecessary Effect: one that sets state from other state or props.
Here the Effect filters todos into another state variable. First React renders with a stale list, then the Effect runs and renders again.

slides.code:
// ✅ calculated during render
const visible = filterTodos(todos, tab);
slides.say: Just calculate it during render. No extra state, no Effect.

slides.text: Faster (no cascade), simpler (less code), safer (nothing to get out of sync).
slides.say: It is faster, because there is no extra render. Simpler, with less code. And safer, because nothing can get out of sync.
